rust_declaration.name: into_flattened

trusted_assumptions: The lower contract for Vec::into_raw_parts_with_alloc yields valid raw parts and preserves the input sequence in raw_vec_view.
The lower contract for usize::unchecked_mul returns mathematical multiplication when the product fits in usize.
The lower contract for Vec::from_raw_parts_in constructs the sequence represented by valid raw parts.
axiom_raw_array_capacity_fits: a valid Vec<[T; N]> allocation has cap * N fitting in usize when T is non-ZST.
axiom_raw_array_reinterpretation: recasting valid [T; N] raw parts as T preserves allocation validity and changes the raw view to the flattened array view.
The vstd contracts for usize::checked_mul and Option::expect provide the checked ZST-branch arithmetic.
rationale: Rust 1.96 control flow is preserved; T::IS_ZST and ptr.cast() are mechanically inlined to their definitions. The proof composes smaller raw-parts contracts with explicit raw-layout representation axioms.
